description: Four tap delay modelled on the Buchla 277. Patching an output back into an input builds a feedback loop, which overloads as the input level rises

params.text: An attenuverter, -1 to +1, setting the level of the input on that row
The delay time, from 5ms to 200ms, default 100ms
How far the TIME CV moves the delay time, -0.5 to +0.5
Shifts the delay range to 50ms to 2000ms in the x 10 position

inputs.text: One of the four inputs into the delay line
A CV setting the level of the input on that row
A CV modulating the delay time

outputs.text: The delayed signal at a quarter of the time set by TIME
The delayed signal at a third of the time set by TIME
The delayed signal at half the time set by TIME
The delayed signal at the full time set by TIME
